Ellen (CSM): Reminder: CedarBridge dedicated bring-up tomorrow 10:00 PT. Committed 14 GPUs across pools cedar-a/cedar-b. Steady target 5.5k qps, burst up to 11k. Need final signoff on autoscale, priming, and billing cap.
Max (SRE): I can run the scenario. Window 10:00-11:30 PT. Plan: seed 15m, steady 45m @5.5k, two 10m bursts. Load cmd: `./loadgen --site cedar --qps 5500 --duration 2700` then `--qps 11000 --duration 600` for bursts. Streaming metrics to #eng-sre.
Diego (SE): I'll handle KV seeding: `rbw-seed --pool=cedar-a,cedar-b --concurrency=35 --duration=900`. Recommend enabling KV persistence on cedar-a. Also will run a cold-start check by draining one replica mid-burst.
Ellen (CSM): @Max @Diego confirm we have 1.2x headroom for autoscale and fallback to hosted if we hit max_replicas. Need billing cap by EOD.
billing-bot: temporary_quota_increase cedarbridge -> approved amount=$1100 window=2026-07-12T17:00:00Z tag=CEDAR-WARMUP
Max (SRE): Autoscale proposal: min_replicas=2, target_util=0.68, max_replicas=18, scale_up_window=60s, scale_down_delay=480s. Overflow fallback route -> redwood-hosted/latency-fallback.
Diego (SE): +1. I'll add a kill-instance test during second burst to validate routing and KV rehydration. Also will collect 6k sample outputs (steady+burst) for quick evals.
Sara (PM): Product asks: 1) record p50/p95/p99 per-route and error-rate; 2) capture a 6k prompt sample and run quick eval for tokenization drift. If p95 >300ms or error_rate >0.8% mark renewal risk and escalate.
Max (SRE): Alerts set: p95 latency >=300ms OR 5xx_rate >=0.8% => page oncall. Dashboards: I'll post Grafana link shortly. If we see token-cache miss storm we'll reduce burst and rerun a controlled pass.
Diego (SE): Runbook snippet:
```
# seed
rbw-seed --pool cedar-a,cedar-b --concurrency 35 --duration 900
# steady
./loadgen --site cedar --qps 5500 --duration 2700 --report ./reports/cedar_steady.json
# bursts
./loadgen --site cedar --qps 9000 --duration 600
./loadgen --site cedar --qps 11000 --duration 600
```
Ellen (CSM): Action items:
- Max: run load window 10:00-11:30 PT, stream to #eng-sre, abort if p95>320ms or 5xx>1%
- Diego: seed 15m prior; run kill/fallback during burst; attach 6k sample outputs
- Sara: prepare quick-eval script and renewal checklist by 09:00 PT
- Ellen: host 15:00 PT enablement + renewal sync, capture feedback in CS tracker
ops-bot: scheduled_job cedarbridge-warmup -> queued for 2026-07-12T17:25:00Z
Max (SRE): I'll post expected dashboards and attach load profiles before the run. If tail latencies spike >350ms we'll throttle immediately and coordinate a rerun.
Ellen (CSM): Thanks team — this thread is the source of truth during the run. Ping me immediately if keys or billing fail.
